gate: P1.3 PC half: committed event -> polling client <= 300 ms; 100 forced reconnects produce a DOM identical to an uninterrupted run (blueprint gates line 857)

latency.latency_definition: t0 = just before the append POST is sent; t1 = the poll client's onEvents fired for that seq. Includes append RTT + parking wakeup + poll response RTT (slightly conservative).

annotations.hash_kind: render-state hash: the FNV hash of the reduceEvent state (items+seq per stream), not a live DOM — node has no DOM. Same events in -> same hash out. The device half must use a real WebView/DOM check to meet the gate wording.
annotations.chaos_errors: 2 non-forced client-side failures (transient; each retried with backoff and succeeded). Expected under load: the two clients and the appender race the parked-slot semaphore (503 busy) and the local connection can reset during abort storms. No data impact: 0 dupes, 0 gaps, identical hashes and cursors.
annotations.commit_note: commit 6a367ce43fb2 is the last PUSHED commit of sitecrew-ai; the working tree intentionally carries uncommitted work (owner no-commit rule). The evidence + harness SHAs of record live in the sitecrew-testers repo (8e912a6 and later).
annotations.accepted_by_boss: P1.3 PC half accepted as the PC half PASS; the device half carries the final P1.3 verdict (p95 <= 300 ms, 0 misses, max reported).
